overall_summary: One fixed elevated backyard security-camera shot follows exactly one Grandma from the upper-right gate across the grass, up the lower-left trampoline steps, onto the trampoline, and into a small first bounce beside three bear cubs.

capture_style: One fixed elevated outdoor security-camera viewpoint with mild fisheye distortion, grain, limited dynamic range, and no camera movement.

visual_realism: The gate, grass route, trampoline, steps, Grandma, and three cubs remain in one continuous physical layout with realistic scale and contact.
